title: When Are Parallel Subagents Effective for Coding? An Empirical Study on Repository Construction
abstract: arXiv:2611.33893v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based coding agents are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks such as building an entire program from a specification. Products like Codex and Claude Code let an agent delegate work to parallel subagents, multiplying run cost, yet it remains unclear whether and when delegation produces a better program. We compare a single agent with a main agent delegating to subagents on repository-construction tasks from NL2Repo and ProgramBench (which also provides an executable reference program). We compare scores at equal time and equal cost, run intervention experiments, and analyze fine-grained behavior. On randomly drawn tasks, parallel subagents raise hidden-test pass rates by only about 1 to 5 percentage points at up to 3.8x the cost of a single agent. Their gain is larger on hard tasks, where we find evidence of three mechanisms. Self-checking: with GPT-5.6 Sol, one sentence telling a single agent to probe the reference program firs

translated_title: 并行子智能体何时对编程有效？关于代码仓库构建的实证研究
translated_abstract: 基于 LLM 的编程智能体越来越多地被用于长程任务，例如根据规格说明构建完整的程序。Codex 和 Claude Code 等产品允许智能体将工作委派给并行的子智能体，这会成倍增加运行成本，但委派是否以及何时能产生更好的程序仍不清楚。我们在来自 NL2Repo 和 ProgramBench 的代码仓库构建任务上（ProgramBench 还提供可执行的参考程序），将单个智能体与由主智能体委派子智能体的方式进行比较。我们在相同时间和相同成本下比较得分，开展干预实验，并分析细粒度的行为。在随机抽取的任务上，并行子智能体仅将隐藏测试通过率提高约 1 到 5 个百分点，而成本高达单个智能体的 3.8 倍。其收益在困难任务上更大，我们发现了支撑三种机制的证据。自我检查：使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 时，只需一句话告诉单个智能体先探测参考程序……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该实证研究发现，并行子智能体在随机任务上仅以高达3.8倍的成本换来约1-5个百分点的通过率提升，其真正收益集中在困难任务上，且主要来自自我检查等三种机制。
en_tdlr: This empirical study finds that parallel subagents deliver only 1-5 percentage-point gains at up to 3.8x cost on random tasks, with their real benefits concentrated on hard tasks and driven by three mechanisms such as self-checking.
